scope: All .rs files recursively beneath crates, including source, tests, benches and inactive cfg branches
kind_inventory: Each unsafe token is classified by the following token as block, function, implementation, trait, extern or other. Extern includes both blocks and function declarations/types. Unclassified macro tokens remain counted as other. Existing per-file totals were verified unchanged when adding kinds.
limitations: Lexical kind counts are not an AST classification and do not prove soundness
Macro definitions are inspected, not expanded
Generated source outside crates and dependencies are excluded
Per-file counts detect substitutions between lexical kinds, not substitutions preserving each kind count
Baseline changes require review; a matching baseline is not approval for new unsafe
